moments.evidence: B assenyala el buit del pont entre dos cubs de suport. El tercer cub i els tres discos són barrejats a la capsa davant d’A.
A posa els tres discos en un compartiment i treu el cub que faltava de l’altre.
A dona el tercer cub a B, que el col·loca de travesser recolzat en els dos cubs de suport.

continuity.anchor: Una capsa amb dos compartiments, tres discos i tres cubs, de mides compatibles amb el pont baix.

construction.narrative: A separa les peces i recupera el cub que permet a B fer un pont i provar-lo amb un disc.

attempts.prompt:
CACE Imatges, school-friendly wordless educational narrative. Deliver one wide landscape image. EXACTLY FOUR equal vertical panels in ONE horizontal row from left to right, with pure white margins and three consistent white gutters. Never merge panels, use a second row, crop the first or last panel or insert an inset panel. Clear simplified setting against white with only needed cues. Medium-wide full-action views, eye-level slightly oblique, matching camera position, perspective, dimensions, anatomy, scale, lighting, hair/fur, clothes and object shapes across panels. Repeat the same two characters scene to scene. Favor visual evidence of their actions, visible distinct hands and physical points of contact. No cut-off hands, warped fingers, floating objects, implausible contact, lettering, branding, numbers, panel labels, arrows, speech bubbles, captions or motion graphics. The internal codes A and B are directions only. Preserve every count and all patterns. Stage the action as a natural coherent story.
Exactly two bipedal anthropomorphic animals with consistent functional paws or hands. Flat educational illustration, simple clean color shapes and smooth dark outlines, flat colors only, white-background context.

Cast: A is GAT, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is GOS, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
A school sorting and building story. THE COMPLETE INVENTORY: three big red, yellow and blue wooden discs, two equally small beige cube piers already on table at right, one long flat dark brown wooden PLANK, one 2-compartment tray at left. Only these six wooden loose pieces in the entire story. Three discs on left beside dark brown plank, no light cube inside tray. Panel 1 B points to the empty gap between the two piers. A sees the plank mixed with discs inside the tray. Panel 2 A places all three discs in their own compartment and grips the very same long plank parallel to tabletop. Panel 3 A passes that same dark long plank to B with both supporting it horizontally above piers. P4 B has set that plank physically across the two cube piers, red disc under the tabletop bridge and two discs in the tray. Two bridge piers and deck only.
attempts.review: El gat tria i dona el travesser al gos, i el final mostra el pont complet i el disc vermell sota el travesser. S’usa la mateixa peça rectangular que a la foto, amb dos cubs de suport i els mateixos tres discos.

alt.ca: El gos assenyala els cubs. El gat li passa una peça allargada i completen el pont amb un disc vermell a sota.
alt.es: El perro señala los cubos. El gato le pasa una pieza alargada y completan el puente con un disco rojo debajo.
